notes.title: Fixes and Content!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Patients![/b]

We have been hard at work fixing the bugs in the game! Additionally, we wanted to give you all some replayability so we cooked up a harder game mode. We wish you all the best of luck in completing it.

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements! Play through the game and collect achievements as you perform certain feats.
[*] New game mode: Hard mode! This mode can be toggled on and off in the main menu's options. In this mode:
[list]
[*] Progress through a board with no item tiles.
[*] Play with the possibility of consecutive encounters.
[*] Lose all your fingers and fail the game after losing a single encounter. 
[/list]
[*] Added new prompts for certain ability uses.
[*] New Environmental elements.
[*] Updated certain models.
[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Encounter rate adjusted to prevent back-to-back encounter tiles in normal mode.
[*] Item text adjusted for certain items, as some descriptions were inaccurate.
[*] Joker card bugs fixed, as this ability was soft locking players at times.
[*] Game board now resets upon completion, win or lose. This was preventing players from playing again.
[/list]

[i][b]Edit: We have been made aware of bugs preventing players from progressing in either game mode, as well as some other minor bugs. These have now been addressed and are fixed in a new minor update. Thank you for your patience and feedback.[/b][/i]

Thank you all again for playing our game, and additionally, if you are interested in BTS and curious how our game was made check out the video below!

 [previewyoutube=_TtChSjZODU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: THANK YOU!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Patients[/b]

We want to say [i]thank you[/i] for the incredible support you have given us on release! 

That being said we are aware of the variety of bugs that have appeared in the build. We will be doing extensive QA testing to ensure we can push an update by the end of the week to fix these issues. Your patience would be greatly appreciated as we are all students starting our next school quarter.

[b]Known Bugs/Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Game board storing progress even after winning the game
[*] Drawing a joker card as your last card results can occasionally softlock players
[*] QOL changes: Animation times, difficulty levels, monster tile positions
[/list]

We will be addressing game-breaking bugs first, QOL changes will be dependent on how much time we have this week.

-Spineless Studios
